title: Sodium Lights
brief: Original Japanese city-pop instrumental: a night drive along an urban bayside highway. Tenor sax carries the vocal-like line; electric piano, clean cutting guitar, finger bass and an acoustic kit play a funk groove in the verses and a disco groove in the choruses; strings, brass stabs and a synth lead for the intro hook, the solo and the last chorus. About 4:20.

sections.intent: Night drive starts: electric piano, sparkle arpeggio and pad; the synth lead states the hook from bar 5 as the hats, kick and bass come in.
Tenor sax enters in its middle register over a syncopated funk groove; cutting guitar joins in the second eight bars.
Build: strings enter low, harmony leaves the tonic, faster harmonic rhythm, a rising sequence; held B-flat sus chord, snare build and a band push into the chorus.
Hook on IV (royal-road start), four-on-the-floor disco groove with open hats, brass stabs, strings sustain; aa-prime chorus ending on a perfect cadence.
Guitar riff answers the hook over the intro vamp.
Shorter verse: snare backbeat instead of side stick, guitar cutting throughout.
Hook again with a violin countermelody in its second half and guitar fills.
Synth-lead solo over a C-minor dorian vamp with ii-V turns; ride cymbal, open filter on CC1.
Breakdown: drums out, sax alone in a falling sequence; F#m9-B7 pivots to E major; snare build and a noise riser.
High point: the chorus a half step up in E, violins high, synth lead doubling the sax an octave up from the second half; the sax peak (F#5) at bar 109.
The hook fades away in fragments over the intro vamp in E; ritardando; Emaj9 rings.

tracks.name: Synth lead (intro hook, solo, last-chorus octave)
Noise riser into the last chorus

decisions: E-flat major for the tenor sax; the last chorus lifts a half step to E through F#m9-B7 after a chromatic A-flat, G, F-sharp root descent in the break.
Chorus starts on IV (Abmaj9-Bb9sus4-Gm7-Cm9, the royal-road shape) and keeps the tonic for its cadence; verse uses ii-V tonicizations and a backdoor iv-bVII (Abm9-Db13).
Verse groove syncopated with side stick; chorus four-on-the-floor with open hats on the off-beats.
The band pushes the chorus chord on the "and" of 4 (harmony entries at beat 3.5) with bass, guitar, electric piano and brass together.
Voicings by musiclib.voicing in dependency order: melody, bass, guitar, strings, pad, electric piano, brass, arpeggio; each under the melody where it plays.
Sax vibrato written as pitch bend on held notes only; crossfade legato on its two recorded dynamics.
authorship: All notes written by compose.py (Claude, music-production 0.3.0 test piece).
